name: Swedish Edmonds Junior Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Help and comfort patients at the hospital and learn about jobs in health care. Based on your age, you may help in Rehab, at the front desk, with patients, in food service or with patient visits.
who_can_apply: You must be at least 14 years old and able to give at least one 3 or 4 hour shift each week.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer. It can count toward a school community service requirement.
duration: At least one 3 to 4 hour shift a week
deadline_text: Closed. The page says the junior application process is closed because of a long wait list, with no new applications until further notice.
how_to_apply: Check the page for when applications reopen. After you send the paperwork, you have an interview with volunteer services. Questions: 425-640-4341, Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.
notes: Swedish's Issaquah and Mill Creek campuses take volunteers 18 and older only. Providence Everett has its own junior program for ages 16 and up.
